tier: WS3c genuine-Apple scattered internal-pool COW plus WS3c-2 multi-CIB shrink
host: macOS 26.6 VM at the pinned lab address, apfs_kext/newfs_apfs 2811.160.7.0.4

source_fixtures.geometry: 135 chunks, 2 CIBs, no CAB, ip_base 10897, ip_block_count 411
source_fixtures.creation: hdiutil 17 GiB sparse image; bare Apple_APFS partition harvested after clean detach

implementation.foreign_detection: A live CIB outside the generated three-slot model adopts authenticated real spaceman geometry. Later commits retain the foreign path from the authenticated volume-superblock formatted_by record rather than address coincidence.
implementation.rotation: New CIB, chunk-0 bitmap, optional CAB, spill bitmaps, and CIB copies are selected from the real IP bitmap plus the two-checkpoint IP free-queue window.
implementation.live_metadata_guard: Every live CAB, CIB, and nonzero ci_bitmap_addr is authenticated, required marked-used, and excluded from allocation.
implementation.queue_update: Consumed aged IP ghosts leave the rebuilt IP free queue; old live COW blocks enter it at the new xid. The used-set clears reclaimed ghosts and marks every new copy.
implementation.generated_layout_behavior: S.A.K.-formatted containers that still match generated packing and slot geometry keep the existing byte-identical three-slot path.

defects_caught_during_certification: The original path rejected genuine multi-chunk Apple COW at nextIpSlot.
Using the four-checkpoint main-data rollback window for the IP queue left no reusable CIB/bitmap pair; the IP ring requires its documented two-checkpoint window.
After the first foreign commit, the new CIB landed at a generated-looking address and the next commit forgot the volume was foreign.
That misclassification reused live chunk-3 bitmap block 10900 as chunk 0's new bitmap; host apfsck reported Chunk-info: wrong count of free blocks from the patch checkpoint onward.
sak_apfs_writer_cli commit-image-resize parsed --new-size-bytes but passed --size-bytes to the writer, making every image resize request current-to-current.

The full 262-test gate caught a classifier regression: an S.A.K.-formatted >1.35 TiB generated container with a relocated multi-block IP ring was routed into the one-block foreign path. Authenticated S.A.K. formatter provenance plus generated inline-array packing now retain the generated path, while nextIpSlot still validates the re-anchored live ring before any write.

cow_chain.apple_pre_mount_fsck: All four checkpoints: volume and container appear to be OK; space manager, both free-queue trees, object maps, fsroot, extent-ref, volume-object-map space, and allocated space clean.
cow_chain.kernel_readback: Insert and patch contents matched exactly; replacement matched exactly; delete target was absent; original/nested neighbor data stayed intact.
cow_chain.kernel_continuation: The kernel advanced the four independent candidates to xids 8, 9, 10, and 11 respectively.
cow_chain.apple_post_kernel_fsck: All four kernel-advanced candidates: volume and container appear to be OK.

shrink_inverse.source: The xid-8 final foreign multi-CIB COW result
shrink_inverse.apple_pre_mount_fsck: Volume and container appear to be OK at xid 9.
shrink_inverse.kernel_readback: Replacement and nested neighbor matched; deleted file remained absent.
shrink_inverse.apple_post_kernel_fsck: Volume and container appear to be OK at xid 12.

hermetic_regression.coverage: Shipped tests run the chained 256 MiB COW path and reconstruct the genuine post-insert 135-chunk/two-CIB metadata state to prove foreign classification and exact live far-bitmap exclusion.
